sections.text: The village lanterns have vanished into Mosswood. A ribbon of green light leads between the trees, while smoke rises from a nearby camp.

options.description: Follow the light to the brook

sections.text: Lanterns drift above a fast brook. Stepping stones lead toward a clearing, but a dry path returns to the camp.

consequence.text: You slip and bruise your knee.

sections.text: An old woodkeeper offers warm soup. She says the lanterns gather where the moon touches the oldest roots.
The missing lanterns circle a sleeping fox. A hollow beneath an ancient oak glows brighter than the rest.
The hollow opens onto a deep root shaft. A narrow ledge crosses it, while the trail home remains clear behind you.

consequence.text: The ledge breaks and you fall into the shaft.

options.description: Leave the hollow and return safely

sections.text: At dawn, the lanterns settle above the village square. Their keepers welcome you with a quiet festival.
You reach home before sunrise and mark the dangerous hollow on the woodkeeper's map.
